ex.en: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
ex.zh: 警方蒐集了很多對他不利的證據。

ex.en: Do you have any evidence that really happened?
ex.zh: 你有證據證明那真的發生過嗎？

ex.en: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.
ex.zh: 除非有可靠的證據，否則我們什麼都不該相信。

ex.en: It is evident that he has made a mistake.
ex.zh: 很明顯他犯了錯。

ex.en: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
ex.zh: 從資料可以明顯看出，年輕人抽菸的情況並沒有減少。

ex.en: He spoke with evident glee.
ex.zh: 他說話時明顯很高興。

ex.en: Nowadays, equal pay is not enough. Household responsibilities must also be distributed evenly.
ex.zh: 現在光是同工同酬已經不夠，家務也必須平均分攤。

ex.en: Spread the sauce evenly over the pizza.
ex.zh: 把醬汁均勻地塗在披薩上。

ex.en: The work was divided evenly among the team members.
ex.zh: 工作平均分配給團隊成員。

ex.en: The eventual cost was much higher than expected.
ex.zh: 最後的費用比預期高出許多。

ex.en: Nobody predicted the eventual winner.
ex.zh: 沒有人料到最後的贏家是誰。

ex.en: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
ex.zh: 有些國家公園提供淋浴間，甚至還有托嬰服務。

ex.en: Even with his glasses, he doesn't see very well.
ex.zh: 他就算戴著眼鏡也看不太清楚。

ex.en: This one is even better.
ex.zh: 這個更好。

ex.en: It's even colder today than yesterday.
ex.zh: 今天比昨天更冷。

ex.en: Even if it rains, the game will be played.
ex.zh: 即使下雨，比賽也會照常舉行。

ex.en: Even if it's expensive, I'll buy it.
ex.zh: 就算很貴，我也要買。

ex.en: Two, four, and six are even numbers.
ex.zh: 二、四、六是偶數。

ex.en: The floor isn't even.
ex.zh: 地板不平。

ex.en: Do you go to school on foot every day?
ex.zh: 你每天走路上學嗎？

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚餵貓。

ex.en: Every employee must wear a badge.
ex.zh: 每位員工都必須配戴識別證。

every.zh: 每隔（every other / every + 數字）

ex.en: I go swimming every other day.
ex.zh: 我每隔一天去游泳。

ex.en: The bus comes every ten minutes.
ex.zh: 公車每十分鐘一班。

ex.en: Do you ever dream about flying through the sky?
ex.zh: 你曾經夢想在天空飛翔嗎？

ex.en: By the way, have you ever been to Hokkaido?
ex.zh: 對了，你去過北海道嗎？

ever.zh: （接在最高級後）有史以來、至今

ex.en: This is the best book that I've ever read.
ex.zh: 這是我讀過最好的書。

ex.en: This is the biggest cat that I've ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最大的貓。

ex.en: This is the finest view I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最美的景色。

ex.en: I've lived here ever since I was a child.
ex.zh: 我從小就住在這裡。

ex.en: He has been happier ever since.
ex.zh: 從那之後他就快樂多了。

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早晚餵貓。

ex.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.
ex.zh: 今晚跟你聊天我很開心。

ex.en: The President is to speak on television this evening.
ex.zh: 總統今晚將在電視上發表演說。

ex.en: I eventually got used to it.
ex.zh: 最後我還是習慣了。

ex.en: Dan and Linda eventually moved to London.
ex.zh: 丹和琳達最後搬到了倫敦。

ex.en: Such secrets are always eventually revealed.
ex.zh: 這種秘密最後總會被揭露。

ex.en: I've looked everywhere, but I can't find my wallet.
ex.zh: 我到處都找了，就是找不到我的錢包。

ex.en: If I were rich, I would go travelling everywhere.
ex.zh: 如果我很有錢，就會到處去旅行。

ex.en: New buildings are being built here, there and everywhere.
ex.zh: 這裡到處都在蓋新大樓。

ex.en: TV plays an important part in everyday life.
ex.zh: 電視在日常生活中扮演重要的角色。

ex.en: Smartphones have become part of everyday life.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機已經成為日常生活的一部分。

ex.en: This jacket is perfect for everyday use.
ex.zh: 這件外套很適合日常穿著。

ex.en: It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.
ex.zh: 要分辨善惡並不容易。

ex.en: A baby has no knowledge of good and evil.
ex.zh: 嬰兒不懂得分辨善惡。

ex.en: The villain in the movie is truly evil.
ex.zh: 電影裡的反派真的很邪惡。

ex.en: He believed that money was not evil in itself.
ex.zh: 他認為金錢本身並不邪惡。

ex.en: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 一提到演化論，我們就會想到達爾文。

ex.en: They opposed Darwin's theory of evolution.
ex.zh: 他們反對達爾文的演化論。

ex.en: The evolution of smartphones has been very fast.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機的演進非常快速。

ex.en: This book explains the evolution of the English language.
ex.zh: 這本書說明英語的演變。

ex.en: Software is constantly evolving.
ex.zh: 軟體一直在不斷演進。

ex.en: The company has evolved from a small shop into a global brand.
ex.zh: 這家公司從一間小店發展成國際品牌。

ex.en: Our plans evolved as the project went on.
ex.zh: 隨著專案進行，我們的計畫也逐步調整。

ex.en: Scientists believe birds evolved from dinosaurs.
ex.zh: 科學家認為鳥類是從恐龍演化而來的。

ex.en: These animals evolved to survive in the desert.
ex.zh: 這些動物演化出在沙漠中生存的能力。

ex.en: Scientists study the evolutionary history of birds.
ex.zh: 科學家研究鳥類的演化史。

ex.en: Fear is an evolutionary response to danger.
ex.zh: 恐懼是面對危險時演化出來的反應。

ex.en: The new model is an evolutionary step, not a revolution.
ex.zh: 新機型只是漸進式的改良，不是革命性的突破。

ex.en: The company prefers evolutionary change over sudden reform.
ex.zh: 公司偏好漸進式改變，而非突然改革。

ex.en: The company holds a charity event every year.
ex.zh: 公司每年都會舉辦慈善活動。

ex.en: How many people attended the event?
ex.zh: 有多少人參加這場活動？

ex.en: Many important historical events took place 7000 years B.C.
ex.zh: 西元前七千年左右發生了許多重要的歷史事件。

ex.en: He organized a classroom debate on current events.
ex.zh: 他組織了一場關於時事的課堂辯論。

ex.en: The event is still fresh in our memory.
ex.zh: 那件事在我們的記憶中依然鮮明。

ex.en: In any event, I will do my best.
ex.zh: 無論如何，我都會盡力。

ex.en: In any event, we should leave before dark.
ex.zh: 無論如何，我們都應該在天黑前出發。

ex.en: Employees receive a performance evaluation every year.
ex.zh: 員工每年都會接受績效考核。

ex.en: The evaluation showed that the program was successful.
ex.zh: 評估顯示這個計畫很成功。

ex.en: The people were evacuated because of the flood.
ex.zh: 人們因為洪水被疏散了。

ex.en: We have less than five minutes to evacuate the whole building.
ex.zh: 我們只有不到五分鐘的時間疏散整棟大樓。

ex.en: We will evaluate the results at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 我們會在月底評估結果。

ex.en: Teachers evaluate students in different ways.
ex.zh: 老師用不同的方式評量學生。
